## What was implemented

**`apps/docs/lib/openAi.ts`** (new) — Exports `OpenAIClientInterface` with `createContentEmbedding(text: string): Promise<Result<number[], ApiErrorGeneric>>`, plus a lazy `openAI()` singleton factory.
